views.name: converted_regions_with_cytoband
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cc.RefNo AS ref_no,
  cc.CaseNo AS case_no,
  cc.InvNo AS inv_no,
  cc.Clone AS clone_no,
  cc.Chr AS chromosome,
  cc.ChrOrd AS chr_ord,
  cc.Start AS start_pos,
  cc.`End` AS end_pos,
  cc.Type AS region_type,
  cc.CellsPresent AS cells_present,
  cb.cytoband_name AS cytoband_name,
  cb.hg38_start AS band_start,
  cb.hg38_stop AS band_stop,
  CASE WHEN cb.hg38_start IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS overlaps_cytoband
FROM
  `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
LEFT JOIN
  `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb
ON cc.Chr = cb.chromosome
  AND NOT (cc.`End` < cb.hg38_start OR cc.Start > cb.hg38_stop)
ORDER BY ref_no, case_no, inv_no, clone_no, chromosome, start_pos
grain: one row per converted genomic region (with possible multiple rows if region overlaps multiple cytobands)
views.description: One row per converted cytogenetic region (from CytoConverted) annotated with hg38 cytoband overlap. Exposes genomic coords, chromosome, type, cells_present and matched cytoband_name and overlap flags/counts. Useful for region-level summaries, mapping abnormalities to cytobands, or aggregating recurrent hotspots. | Use for: aggregate regions by cytoband to find recurrent hotspots; filter regions overlapping specific cytobands or chromosomes; join to KaryAbnorm/KaryBreak to connect textual breakpoints to genomic coordinates
